messages.content: Hi there, weekly check-in from Northline Care. Hope the week treated you alright. How are you feeling, and have you had a chance to check your blood sugar at all?
Not really. Insurance denied my test strips back in August and the appeal's still going nowhere. I've only gotten maybe three checks the whole month.

That's a real frustrating spot to be in, and I'm sorry. I have to be straight with you — insurance disputes are outside what I'm able to help with here. For the readings you did manage to get, do you remember any of the numbers?
One was 238 on Monday before breakfast. And I've had this dull headache hanging around most of the week. Hard to shake.

Thank you for sharing that. I'm logging the 238 fasting reading now. A number that high before eating, along with the headaches you're describing — I want to get a nurse to follow up with you on this. I just sent the flag over. Median response time right now is 31 hours, so someone should reach out by tomorrow evening.
Alright. I just hope they can actually help. Been feeling off for a couple weeks honestly.
Hang in there. The nurse will have your full picture and can talk through what's going on properly. I'll schedule your next check-in for next week. Take care of yourself in the meantime.

theme: insurance denied test strips or a claim question
